scope: Eight support source sheets, 16 poses each, imagegen-native redraw from exact source crops and corresponding premium canonical. Generated PNGs remain byte-for-byte untouched. No packing/import/production changes.
nativeCheckLimit: Independent read-only System.Drawing alpha128 8-connected-component count >=1000px, alpha pixel count and strong outer margins. This is NOT Unity Pack, full RGBA assignment, or continuous rendered motion validation.

records.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production transparent SD tactical-RPG animation sprite sheet. Image 1 is the EXACT POSE/ORDER/DIRECTION reference; image 2 is the APPROVED character anatomy and crisp illustration style canonical. Redraw all sixteen full-body poses from image 1 natively in the same larger-skull, compact short-torso/short-leg proportions and finely drawn face/hair/glasses/cloth/armor/boots quality as image 2. This is a new illustration, not an upscale. Do NOT copy image 2's walking poses. Keep every image-1 hand placement, stance, gaze, weapon visibility/occlusion and angle. The head/torso/boot proportions must remain the same model across all sixteen poses, without shrinking the head in the final recovery poses. Preserve the exact original weapon type, number, silhouette and which hand holds it. Four columns, FOUR populated rows, sixteen distinct isolated bodies, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom exactly as image 1; the optional bottom fifth row stays completely empty. All 16 figures complete including long weapon tips, hair and boots; give each independent transparent space so no strong art touches adjacent figures or canvas edges. Ignore tiny disconnected crop-fragments at cell edges in image 1; those are NOT body parts or extra poses. True RGBA transparent background, no black/white/checkerboard fill, no ground, no text, no labels, no grid, no border, no effects, no added accessories, no cast shadows. Sharp native clean linework and rich small-scale painted details. Keep four view orientations per row exactly from image 1, never turn a back view into front. Output only this one sheet.
Character: Jade, long brown hair, rectangular blue glasses, navy-and-gold uniform, dark boots, one black/gold spear with silver-blue point. Group PixelCampaign-jade-hq. Row1 idle with upright spear; row2 horizontal forward thrust; row3 vertical defensive two-hand spear; row4 diagonally held ready stance. Pose image1 is authoritative. Match image2's compact skull-to-body model.
records.poseReview: 16 poses: idle upright / horizontal thrust / vertical guard / diagonal ready. Four facing orders retained, back heads remain obscured. Generic spear stays single; native skull/chest/boots match compact premium more closely.
records.status: candidate-native-and-pose-reviewed; Unity packing and continuous transition review pending
